claim: When you migrate a hosted zone by editing the exported records file, and the zone contains aliases that refer to other records in the same hosted zone, move the alias records to the bottom of the file, because Route 53 must create the record that an alias record refers to before it can create the alias record. If an alias record refers to another alias record, the alias target must appear first in the file.

qualifiers.condition: the hosted zone contains aliases that refer to other records in the same hosted zone

evidence.quote: Move the alias records to the bottom of the file. Route 53 must create the record that an alias record refers to before it can create the alias record.
If the hosted zone contains any aliases that refer to other records in the same hosted zone, make the following changes:
If one or more alias records refer to other alias records, the records that are the alias target must appear in the file before the referencing alias records.
